Vendored from https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs at commit
04f46c6a0708418cb7b96fc563eacae0fbf77674 (qrcodejs 1.0.0).
No runtime CDN or QR generation API is used by the ICA admin QR feature.
The pinned encoder matrix is rendered as integer modules with a four-module
quiet zone for high resolution PNG printing. No database writes are required.
